Table of Contents / Engines and Platforms

  • Apache Apex (⭐350) - Unified platform for big data stream and batch processing.
  • Apache Flink (⭐26k) - Distributed engine for stateful computation over bounded and unbounded data streams.
  • Apache Kafka (⭐34k) - Distributed event streaming platform for high-performance data pipelines and applications.
  • Apache Samza (⭐846) - Distributed stream processing framework built on Apache Kafka with standalone and YARN deployment options.
  • Apache Spark Streaming (⭐44k) - Scalable, fault-tolerant stream processing on Apache Spark.
  • Esper (⭐875) - Complex event processing, Streaming SQL, and event series analysis engine.
  • hailstorm (⭐94) - Distributed stream processing with exactly-once semantics based on Storm.
  • Hazelcast Jet (⭐1.1k) - Stream and batch processing engine whose development moved into Hazelcast Platform.
  • Onyx (⭐2.1k) - Distributed, masterless, fault-tolerant data processing platform.
  • SABER (⭐44) - Window-based hybrid CPU/GPU stream processing engine.
  • SPQR (⭐30) - Dynamic framework for processing high-volume data streams through pipelines.
  • Teknek (⭐10) - Stream processing platform with the interactive Stream Operator Language shell.

  • Swave (⭐173) - Lightweight Reactive Streams infrastructure toolkit for Scala.

  • Turbine (⭐833) - Netflix tool for aggregating Server-Sent Event JSON streams.
